segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the reformulated, stickier patches were harder to remove and left star-shaped blemishes and itchiness lasting for days, a stronger reaction than she recalls from the earlier version (1-star).
segments.normal: One reviewer nearing 40 describes her skin as normal and no longer oily, and says the patches still stick well and reduce the size of occasional blemishes overnight.

concerns.barrier: Reviewers use the patches to physically protect broken or flared skin from bacteria and picking, including one with an autoimmune skin condition who reports flare-ups heal faster and less painfully when covered.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report the patches noticeably reduce redness by morning, describing the effect as calming as well as concealing.
concerns.blemishes: The large majority of reviewers report the patches visibly shrink and flatten pimples, often overnight to within a few days, and pull out visible debris; however, some report the patches do not stick well enough to stay effective, including one who found they did little at all and preferred a competing brand, and another whose patches lifted and fell off within hours.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the patches absorb oil from the blemish area effectively, describing them as soaking up a lot of oil along with other fluid.

aspects.libelle: Fun colors and star shape draw compliments
Stays on for hours, even through showering or sleep
Large pack lasts a long time, refills affordable
Reformulated stars are stickier and harder to remove
Adhesion inconsistent, patches can fall off early
Packaging makes patches hard to peel without touching adhesive
Pricier than competing pimple patch brands

extraits.titre: I do not like the new formula
extraits.texte: "2x stickier" and twice as damaging to my sensitive skin. I used to love the black stars because they go with everything and they provide an elevated look compared to any other color star, but this new formula is too sticky: it is increasingly difficult to remove the stars from my face after wear, and now, I'm left with star-shaped blemishes lasting days and only accentuating the original issue. Itchy and unappealing: thumbs down.

I tried these today to see what all the hype is, and now I have no idea why there is any hype for it. I got the black stars because I thought they would match my outfits better than ask the others, which they do. However, they aren't sticky at all, I put some moisturizer over and around the patch because I heard that helps but it so didn't work, I kept finding the patches in my hair throughout the day. They were for sure over priced for what they are, they are basically little stickers with hydrocollid that doesn't do much at all. It's a fun idea but for sure needs work. I prefer the HERO Mighty Patches, they work so much better and actually stick to my face even when I'm tossing around in my sleep. Hope this was helpful.

I don't use it for acne. I have an autoimmune related skin condition and when I have a flareup these little stars help it heal 10 times more quickly and painlessly. Plus they're infinitely cuter than the spots from the flareup.

I'm approaching 40 and I don't really get breakouts anymore, but if I do get a rogue blemish these are fantastic. They stick super well (although my skin is normal and not oily anymore) and I try to leave them on all day and night for a few reasons: 1. it keeps me from picking, and 2. I feel like the longer you leave them on, the more effective they are. These reduced the "dome" on two issues I had on my face just recently and made the next day's makeup application a breeze. I SO wish I had these when I was at my peak oily/acne prone age. These particular patches are a great size (larger than others I've tried) and cute as well. I'd recommend these to anyone!

extraits.titre: My Favorite! Super Cute and STAY ON!
extraits.texte: I have hormonal acne on my cheeks and chin. I love putting these hydrocolloid stars over pimples that have already popped to keep bacteria/makeup from getting in the wound. They speed up the healing process of pimples immensely because they protect broken skin and absorb fluid. They also look super adorable. I especially love the black stars!! Even though Starface is a little pricier than other pimple patches, these look good and will STAY as long as you apply them over clean skin (EVEN WHEN SHOWERING AND SWEATING)!!!. I can't go back to other brands!

These extra-large Hydro-Star patches are amazing for bigger spots. The xl stars cover the whole area really well and stay super sticky without lifting or peeling. They absorb everything overnight and noticeably reduce redness by the morning. I also like that they help stop me from touching or picking my skin. Cute, effective, and definitely a must-have for breakouts ⭐

I really love the earthy, neutral tone of these stars. They blend in a bit more seamlessly than the bright colors, making them perfect for wearing during the daytime or on video calls. They have the same amazing sticking power and do a fantastic job of absorbing oil and flattening spots.
